hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Tension rod
function: The inner rod of the adapter kit that holds the plug mandrel up while the sleeve pushes down, so the plug compresses.

tabs.overview: Loads through the shear ring; retrieved with the tool.
tabs.engineering: Steel rod; thread to the plug shear connection.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
